nomineeExplain: A nominee is someone the institution can receive a claim from after the holder dies. Nomination helps the process; it does not decide who legally inherits. If you have not checked, choose “Not sure”.
dateExample: Example: 14 / 09 / 2026 means 14 September 2026. Use the date on your record.
submissionExample: Use the day you sent the request. Example: 14 / 09 / 2026.
statementExample: A statement showing nominee names OR “Nomination: Yes”. A balance alone is not enough.
registrationExample: A bank, broker or fund letter/email confirming nomination is registered for this account. A request receipt is different.
requiredInstitution: Enter the bank, broker or fund name shown on your record.
requiredRecord: Choose the type of record you checked.
requiredCheck: Confirm that your record actually shows the nominee registered for this account.
institutionExample: For example: HDFC Bank, or the name on your statement.
nomineeNoteExample: For example: Spouse / Anu. Nickname or relationship only.
last4Example: For example: 1234. Last four digits only.
recordNoteExample: Optional: a short note to help you find the receipt or record.
bankLocation: Use the bank name on your passbook, statement or deposit receipt.
dematLocation: Use the broker or bank on your demat statement, rather than the company whose shares you hold.
mfLocation: Use the mutual fund on your folio statement. Its registrar can help; units in demat follow the demat route.
checkLocation: Look for the nominee name or nomination status in this account’s details or latest statement.
askInstitution: If it is not shown, ask the institution: “Is nomination registered for this account? Can you confirm it in writing?”
keepUnknown: Keep “Not sure” until you can check. If the institution confirms no nominee, choose “Not added”.
submitKeep: Submit through the institution’s official channel. Keep the dated acknowledgement or receipt.
confirmRegistration: Check a statement or written confirmation that identifies this account and records the nomination. A request receipt alone does not confirm registration.
followRequest: Use the request date and receipt reference to ask the institution whether nomination was registered.
waitRegistration: Keep this as awaiting confirmation until the registration record is available.
hdfcPath: NetBanking: Accounts → your account → Account Details → nominee/holder details.
hdfcHolding: Sole holder: add/change there. For joint holders, the bank recommends a branch visit together.
homeTitle: Make your family’s accounts easier to find.
homeIntro: Check who is nominated. Take care of what is missing. Leave a clear record for your family.
typeQuestion: What kind of account is it?
dematDescription: Shares held with a broker or bank
bankDescription: Savings or a deposit with a bank
mfDescription: A folio held with a mutual fund
missingGuide: Use the institution’s nomination option or ask for its current form.
title: Your family accounts
intro: Keep track of nominees. Take care of what’s missing.
emptyIntro: Demat, bank or mutual fund. Check who is nominated, one account at a time.
allClear: Keep these records up to date
extra: Add a nickname or last four digits
noIds: Use nicknames. Keep full account numbers, PAN and passwords out of this list.
registerTask: Add a nominee with your institution
confirmTask: Check that the request was registered
recordTask: Keep the confirmation with your records
dematGuide: Use the broker or bank that manages this demat account. Ask for the current nomination form or its official online option.
bankGuide: Use your bank’s branch or its official nomination facility, if available online. Ask for the current deposit nomination form.
mfGuide: Use the mutual fund or its registrar’s official service centre or online option. If the units are held in demat, use the demat account’s nomination route.
checkGuide: Check the latest statement or ask the institution. A remembered nomination may need confirmation.
receiptGuide: Keep the receipt. Then check a statement or confirmation showing the nominee was actually registered.
institutionOnly: Virasat keeps your progress. Registration happens with the institution.
sourceNote: Current form and eligibility: confirm with your institution.
confirmationCheck: The record shows the nomination is registered, not just that a request was received.
selfReport: Entered by you. Virasat has not checked institutional records.
removeAsk: Remove this account from your list?
summaryIntro: Review what your family needs to know before sharing.
summaryNotice: Includes account labels, family/nominee nicknames and last four digits if added. Record notes are omitted. Share only with someone you trust.
saveIntro: Download a locked file. Open it here with the same password when you return.
passwordHelp: At least 12 characters. Keep it safe; we cannot recover it.
saved: Encrypted file downloaded. Keep the password separately.
passwordShort: Use a password of 12 to 256 characters.
cannotUnlock: The password or encrypted file could not be verified.
invalidSave: This saved list is invalid or too large.
invalidAccount: Enter the institution name. Use exactly four digits if adding a reference.
invalidDate: Use a real date, no later than today. Confirmation cannot be before submission.
submissionRequired: Add the date you submitted the request.
confirmationRequired: Add the record type and date, then confirm it shows registration. A receipt alone is not enough.
accountLimit: This list can hold up to 50 accounts.
privacyDetail: Your list stays in browser memory. Reloading clears it. Save an encrypted file to return later. Downloads remain on your device.
translationNotice: Draft translations; fluent-reader review is pending. Official forms keep their original language.
boundary: This list does not determine inheritance rights, discover accounts or submit requests.
clearAsk: Clear the list from this session? Saved downloads will remain.
speechUnavailable: This instruction’s audio is not ready. The written instructions are still here.
optoutNote: Not added may reflect a deliberate opt-out. Check the record and choose with the account holder.
startHelp: Start with a passbook, statement or the app you already use. One account is enough to begin.
howWorksText: We help you check the right place, prepare your next step, and keep the result. Your bank, broker or fund makes the actual change.
searchDemat: Search for your broker or bank
searchHelp: Type a name or abbreviation. You can also enter an institution that is not listed.
noMatches: No matches. Check the spelling, or keep the name you entered.
contextHelp: These details help us show the right instructions. It is fine to be unsure.
holderQuestion: Is the account held alone or jointly?
mfMode: How are these mutual funds held?
folioMode: A folio with the mutual fund
identifyText: A fund statement usually shows a folio number and fund name. A demat statement shows a DP ID / Client ID or BO ID. If unsure, ask the provider how the units are held.
prepareIntro: Have these ready for the institution. You do not need to enter them here.
prepareNames: The nominee’s name and relationship, as shown in their records.
prepareMinor: If a nominee is a child, check the date-of-birth and guardian sections on the current form.
prepareAccess: Your own account reference and access to the institution’s official service. Keep passwords and OTPs there only.
jointGuide: For a joint account, involve every holder. Ask the institution which signatures and channel are required before submitting.
unknownContext: Check the holder names and account type on your statement before choosing an online route. The institution can help identify them.
hdfcSavings: In HDFC NetBanking, open Accounts → select the account → Account Details → Nominee and Account Holder details.
hdfcDeposit: In HDFC NetBanking, open FD/RD → select the deposit → look for Add Nominee or Change Nominee. Check this deposit separately from your savings account.
hdfcAction: Sole holders can use Add Nominee or Change Nominee in the relevant account details. For joint holdings, use the bank’s branch route with the other holders.
zerodhaCheck: Open Zerodha Console → Account → Nominees. This nomination also covers mutual funds held in that demat account, including Coin.
zerodhaAction: Use the nomination instructions in Console. Zerodha directs joint holders and people without an Aadhaar-linked mobile to its offline form. Check current requirements on the linked help page.
hdfcMfGuide: Use HDFC Mutual Fund’s nominee-registration service page for the current request form and submission instructions. Match the folio on your statement before starting.
mfDematHelp: These units use the nomination on the demat account. Check that account with your broker or DP; do not assume a separate folio nomination is needed.
routeFallback: We have general guidance for this institution. Confirm the exact screen or form with its official service team.
offlineText: Take your account or folio reference to the branch or official service centre. Ask for nomination registration or a change, and a dated acknowledgement. Ask which holders must attend before travelling.
askText: Please check whether nomination is registered for this account. If it is missing or needs changing, which current form or official online option should I use? Please confirm the result in writing.
followupHelp: This is your own reminder date, not an institution’s deadline. Download it to your calendar if you want an alert.
blockedHelp: Keep the institution’s response. Ask what is missing, which correction is needed, and how to resubmit. A rejected or incomplete request is not a registered nomination.
familyHelp: Add only what will help your family recognise the account and find its records. You can leave private details out.
recordLocation: Where can your family find the record? (optional)
locationHelp: For example: Blue folder at home. This location is included in the family sheet. Do not add passwords or full account numbers.
saveTip: After downloading, look in Downloads for your .virasat file. Keep the password separately. New changes need a new save.
detailsChecked: I also checked the nominee details
receiptExample: “Your request has been received” means the request is pending.
registeredExample: “Nomination registered” or “Nomination: Yes” records registration. Check it identifies this account.
voicePreview: I will read the instructions in your language, one step at a time.
voiceHelp: Audio is included in all six languages. No voice installation is needed. Only the written instructions are played; your entries and passwords stay private.
speechError: Audio could not load. Check your connection, then tap Try again. Your place is kept.
languageHelp: Change language at any time. Your work stays in place.
optoutHelp: This records the holder’s choice in this list only. Any formal opt-out must be completed with the institution. The choice can be reviewed later.
chooseType: Choose an account type to continue.
shareHelp: Choose what to include, then review the sheet below. The downloaded copy is not password-protected.
helpScopeText: This journey is for a living holder arranging nomination. If the holder has died, ask the institution for its deceased-holder claim or transmission process. Do not start a new nomination on their behalf.
openDevice: Open the locked copy on this device
keepDevice: Also keep a locked copy on this device
deviceHelp: Optional: keep a password-protected copy in this browser. You must save again after changes. On a shared device, leave this off. We never store your password.
forgetDevice: Remove the saved copy from this device
forgetDeviceAsk: Remove this device’s locked copy? Downloaded files will remain.
deviceUnavailable: The file was downloaded, but this browser could not keep a device copy. Use the downloaded file to return.
chooseFile: Choose your saved .virasat file or the device copy.
replaceDraft: Start another account? Your unfinished account will be replaced.
replaceList: Opening another list will replace this session. Save your work first if you need it.
validFollowup: Enter a real date, or leave all three boxes empty.
privateRecordHelp: This note is kept in your locked save, and left out of the family summary and page audio.
connectionHelp: Use the demat statement to check that these fund units are held in this exact demat account, with the same holders. Accounts belonging to different family members do not share a nomination.
sameHolders: I checked the statement: these units and holders match this demat account.
replaceChanges: You have unfinished changes. Continuing replaces that draft. Cancel to return Home and finish or save it first.
startOwnHelp: Start a fresh list for your family? This removes the fictional example from this session.
familyReviewCheck: I reviewed what my family should see. I chose to leave any blank fields out.
familyReviewHelp: This is a separate check. A registered nomination does not tell your family where to find the account or its records.
familyReadyNext: Keep this sheet somewhere your trusted family member can find it. Review it when details change.
routeChoice: How would you like to do this?
saveBeforeLeaving: Save your place before opening the official service. Come back here to record what happened.
offlineContact: Use the institution's official help page to locate a branch or service centre. Ask whether it handles nomination for this account before travelling.
offlineBring: Ask which form, holder signatures and documents are needed. Take a statement or passbook to identify the account; keep originals with you unless the institution requires them.
offlineAsk: Ask staff to check the existing nomination first. If a change is needed, ask for a dated receipt and how to obtain the final registration record.
scopeGeneral: General guidance for this account type. We have not reviewed this institution's exact screens.
scopeHdfc: HDFC Bank: savings and FD/RD guidance; joint holders use the branch route.
scopeSbi: SBI deposit accounts. This guide covers available channels; it does not claim a tested login sequence.
scopeAxis: Axis Bank savings accounts only. FD/RD routes may differ.
scopeZerodhaAdd: Zerodha: first nominee addition. Joint accounts or unavailable Aadhaar-linked mobile access need institution assistance.
scopeZerodhaChange: Zerodha: changing existing nominee details or adding another nominee.
scopeGroww: Groww demat account. Existing mutual-fund folios can require a separate service route.
scopeHdfcMf: HDFC Mutual Fund folios. Demat-held units follow the demat account's nomination.
scopeDematFunds: First identify and check the demat account holding these units.
scopeUnknownFunds: The holding format must be identified before choosing a nomination route.
sbiAction: SBI offers deposit-account nomination through YONO, Internet Banking and branches. Choose the specific account. If the option you need is unavailable, ask a branch to register or change it using the current form.
axisStart: In Axis Internet Banking, open Services → Account Services → Update Nominee. Select the savings account, then Add New Nominee or Change Nominee.
axisSubmit: Axis's help page describes generating a request form, completing and signing it, uploading it, and confirming with the NetSecure code. If you cannot print or upload, use a branch.
zerodhaChangeForms: Open Zerodha's change instructions. Get the current nomination and account-modification forms; enter the existing and proposed nominee details as directed.
zerodhaChangeSubmit: Zerodha describes signing both forms by hand, eSigning them, and attaching them to a support ticket. Follow the current instructions; ask support for an alternative if you cannot eSign.
growwCheck: In Groww, open Profile → Account Details → Nominee Details. Check which investment or account the displayed nomination applies to.
growwAction: Use Edit Nominee for eligible demat investments and follow Groww's verification. Updating the profile does not establish that every existing mutual-fund folio changed; check those folios separately.
voiceSetup: Add a voice for this language
voiceSetupHelp: Voice availability depends on your device and browser. Install a matching language voice, then check again. A different accent may be available in the voice list.
androidVoice: Android: Settings → Accessibility → Text-to-speech output. Choose a language; open the engine settings to install voice data.
appleVoice: Apple devices: open Accessibility settings and look for Read & Speak or Spoken Content, then Voices. Names vary by system version.
voiceFallback: If your browser still offers no voice, use your device's screen reader or read the same written guidance. Virasat will not substitute the wrong language.
readingPreferences: Reading settings are remembered on this device. Account details are saved only when you choose Save. Reset clears these reading preferences.
savedNext: Your locked copy is ready. Keep the file and password somewhere you can find again. Return to your task when you are ready.
olderDeviceCopy: The device copy was not updated. Open the downloaded file for your latest changes, or save again with the device option selected.
audioBlocked: Tap Continue listening to play the next part.
audioData: Audio loads only when you listen. Recently played instructions can work offline on supported browsers. First-time listening needs internet.
audioDraft: These are computer-generated voices. Pronunciation is still being reviewed. Follow the written instructions if you hear a difference.
audioCleared: Saved audio removed. Your account list is unchanged.
audioPrivacy: Only public instructions are saved for listening again. Audio requests use this website; no entries are sent to a voice service. Hosting logs can include your IP address and requested audio files.
